At least 17 people booked at Rankin County facility on Aug. 2
By
I. M. FowlerAt least 17 people were booked at a facility in Rankin County, Mississippi, on Aug. 2, 2026.
The "Other" category appeared in nine listed-charge entries, and the "Traffic" category appeared in three. The "Warrant" and "Domestic" categories each appeared twice, and the "Property" category appeared once. The most common listed charge was "COURTESY HOLD," appearing in six charge entries. "[M] DUI: FIRST OFFENSE" appeared in three charge entries.
Booking records show charges as listed at the time of booking. Individuals named have not been convicted of the charges based on this record.
